ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm / Static Kitten) RMM-tool initial access — Atera / ScreenConnect / RemoteUtilities installer launched from email
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's signature tradecraft of weaponizing legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management (RMM) tools — Atera Agent, ConnectWise ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities (rutserv), SimpleHelp, Syncro, MeshAgent — as their primary RAT. Detection fires when these RMM binaries execute from a user-writable path or are spawned by a browser/Outlook/archiver, optionally correlated with a preceding click on the lure URL.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","setup_atera.exe","AgentPackageSTRemote.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","SimpleHelpRemoteSupport.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","Syncro.Installer.exe","MeshAgent.exe") by host, user, Processes.process_name, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process, Processes.process_path, Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","explorer.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","msiexec.exe") OR like(process_path,"%\\Users\\Public\\%") OR like(process_path,"%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%") OR like(process_path,"%\\Downloads\\%") OR like(process_path,"%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["AteraAgent.exe","setup_atera.exe","AgentPackageSTRemote.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","SimpleHelpRemoteSupport.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","Syncro.Installer.exe","MeshAgent.exe"]);
let RmmDeliveryDomains = dynamic(["atera.com","screenconnect.com","control.connectwise.com","remoteutilities.com","rutserv.com","simple-help.com","syncromsp.com","meshcentral.com","onehub.com","file.io","sync.com"]);
let RmmClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough","UrlScanInProgress")
    | where Url has_any (RmmDeliveryDomains) or Url has_any (".msi",".exe",".pdf",".html")
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, NetworkMessageId;
let RmmInstalls = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (RmmInstallers)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Roaming\")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","explorer.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","msiexec.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$";
RmmInstalls
| join kind=leftouter RmmClicks on $left.AccountUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| extend MinutesAfterClick = iff(isnotempty(ClickTime), datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ClickTime), int(null))
| where isnull(MinutesAfterClick) or (MinutesAfterClick between (0 .. 240))   // 4h window from click → install
| project Timestamp, ClickTime, MinutesAfterClick, DeviceName, AccountUpn,
          RmmBinary = FileName, RmmPath = FolderPath, RmmCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          LureUrl = Url, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmInstallers = dynamic([@"\AteraAgent.exe", @"\setup_atera.exe", @"\AgentPackageSTRemote.exe", @"\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe", @"\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe", @"\ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe", @"\rutserv.exe", @"\rfusclient.exe", @"\SimpleHelpRemoteSupport.exe", @"\SyncroSetup.exe", @"\Syncro.Installer.exe", @"\MeshAgent.exe"]);
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic([@"\outlook.exe", @"\explorer.exe", @"\chrome.exe", @"\msedge.exe", @"\firefox.exe", @"\brave.exe", @"\winrar.exe", @"\7zg.exe", @"\msiexec.exe"]);
let SuspiciousPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Roaming\"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where TargetProcessName has_any (RmmInstallers)
| where ActingProcessName has_any (SuspiciousParents)
   or TargetProcessName has_any (SuspiciousPaths)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, Hash
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater RMM Tool Installation from Phishing Context
id: 7b8a32f1-9fb6-4d50-9b1e-9c5e1d4a6f01
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (G0069 / Mango Sandstorm / Static Kitten) staging of legitimate RMM tools (Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, Syncro, MeshAgent) launched from user-writable paths or spawned by browser/Outlook/archive utilities — the actor's signature post-spearphish RAT delivery pattern.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/04/07/mercury-and-dev-1084-destructive-attack-on-hybrid-environment/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.command-and-control
    - attack.t1219.002
    - attack.t1566.002
    - attack.t1204.001
    - attack.t1204.002
    - attack.g0069
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_rmm:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\AteraAgent.exe'
            - '\setup_atera.exe'
            - '\AgentPackageSTRemote.exe'
            - '\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe'
            - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
            - '\ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe'
            - '\rutserv.exe'
            - '\rfusclient.exe'
            - '\SimpleHelpRemoteSupport.exe'
            - '\SyncroSetup.exe'
            - '\Syncro.Installer.exe'
            - '\MeshAgent.exe'
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\outlook.exe'
            - '\explorer.exe'
            - '\chrome.exe'
            - '\msedge.exe'
            - '\firefox.exe'
            - '\brave.exe'
            - '\winrar.exe'
            - '\7zg.exe'
            - '\msiexec.exe'
    selection_path:
        Image|contains:
            - '\Users\Public\'
            - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
            - '\Downloads\'
            - '\AppData\Roaming\'
    condition: selection_rmm and (selection_parent or selection_path)
falsepositives:
    - Sanctioned IT-deployed RMM should originate from C:\Program Files (x86)\<vendor>\ paths and from sccm/intune/msiexec invoked by SYSTEM with the vendor MSI signed cert — tune those out via an allow-list of authorised customer IDs / signing thumbprints.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\ateraagent.exe OR *\\setup_atera.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe OR *\\screenconnect.clientsetup.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe OR *\\rutserv.exe OR *\\RUTSERV.EXE OR *\\rfusclient.exe OR *\\SimpleHelpRemoteSupport.exe OR *\\Syncro.Installer.exe OR *\\SyncroSetup.exe OR *\\MeshAgent.exe) AND (@ParentImage:(*\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\brave.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7zg.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MSIEXEC.EXE) OR @Image:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\downloads\\*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(AteraAgent|setup_atera|AgentPackageSTRemote|ScreenConnect\.ClientSetup|ScreenConnect\.ClientService|ConnectWiseControl\.ClientSetup|rutserv|rfusclient|SimpleHelpRemoteSupport|SyncroSetup|Syncro\.Installer|MeshAgent)\.exe$/i
| (ParentBaseFileName=/^(outlook|explorer|chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|winrar|7zg|msiexec)\.exe$/i OR regex("\\\\(Users\\\\Public|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|AppData\\\\Roaming|Downloads)\\\\", field=ImageFileName))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Multiple public reports (Microsoft Threat Intelligence on Mango Sandstorm/MERCURY, Mandiant on TEMP.Zagros, CISA AA22-055A) document MuddyWater as the most consistent state-aligned abuser of legitimate RMM software for initial access and persistence — pivoting from password-spray and HTML-smuggled lures into Atera, ScreenConnect (DEV-1084 / MERCURY destructive ops in 2023), RemoteUtilities, Simple

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater PowGoop loader — GoogleUpdate.exe DLL sideload spawning PowerShell/cmd
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's PowGoop loader (documented by Mandiant and PaloAlto Unit 42 across 2021–2024 MuddyWater intrusions) where the legitimately-signed Google Update binary is co-located with a trojanised goopdate.dll and a Goopdate.dat PowerShell payload — DLL search-order hijack causes GoogleUpdate.exe to load the rogue DLL and ultimately spawn powershell.exe with the staged loader, a behaviour essentially never observed legitimately.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="GoogleUpdate.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") by host, user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process_path, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.process_path, Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT like(parent_process_path,"%\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\%") AND NOT like(parent_process_path,"%\\Program Files\\Google\\%") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let GoopdateSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "GoogleUpdate.exe"
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              LoaderCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let SideloadedDll = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "goopdate.dll"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "GoogleUpdate.exe"
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\Google\"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DllPath = FolderPath, DllSha256 = SHA256;
let StagedDat = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("Goopdate.dat","config.txt")
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\Google\"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, StagedFile = FolderPath;
GoopdateSpawn
| union SideloadedDll, StagedDat
| summarize SpawnEvents = countif(isnotempty(ChildImage)),
            DllLoadEvents = countif(isnotempty(DllPath)),
            StagedFileEvents = countif(isnotempty(StagedFile)),
            AnyLoaderPath = any(LoaderPath),
            AnyChildCmd = any(ChildCmd),
            AnyDllPath = any(DllPath),
            AnyStaged = any(StagedFile),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName
| where SpawnEvents > 0 or (DllLoadEvents > 0 and StagedFileEvents > 0)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActingProcessName endswith @"\GoogleUpdate.exe"
| where TargetProcessName has_any (@"\powershell.exe", @"\pwsh.exe", @"\cmd.exe", @"\rundll32.exe", @"\wscript.exe", @"\cscript.exe")
| where ActingProcessName !contains @"\Program Files (x86)\Google\"
    and ActingProcessName !contains @"\Program Files\Google\"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, Hash
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater PowGoop Loader - GoogleUpdate.exe Spawning Shell
id: 4e9d2cb8-1a31-44b1-bf65-3d2a7f9b4e02
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (G0069) PowGoop loader execution pattern. PowGoop drops a legitimate signed GoogleUpdate.exe alongside a malicious goopdate.dll and Goopdate.dat outside the canonical Google install path; DLL side-loading causes GoogleUpdate.exe to ultimately spawn powershell.exe (or other interpreters) — GoogleUpdate has no legitimate reason to spawn a shell.
references:
    - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/muddywater-iran-cyber-espionage
    - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/muddywater-powgoop-loader/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.defense-evasion
    - attack.t1574.002
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.t1027.010
    - attack.g0069
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\rundll32.exe'
            - '\wscript.exe'
            - '\cscript.exe'
    filter_legit_google:
        ParentImage|contains:
            - '\Program Files (x86)\Google\'
            - '\Program Files\Google\'
    condition: selection and not filter_legit_google
falsepositives:
    - None expected. GoogleUpdate.exe does not legitimately spawn interactive shells; any hit warrants immediate triage of the parent path and adjacent files (goopdate.dll, Goopdate.dat).
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\googleupdate.exe OR *\\GOOGLEUPDATE.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE) AND NOT @ParentImage:(*\\Program?Files?\(x86\)\\Google\\* OR *\\Program?Files\\Google\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^googleupdate\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|rundll32|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| NOT regex("\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\Google\\\\", field=ParentImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: PowGoop is the closest thing MuddyWater has to a signature implant — Mandiant, PaloAlto Unit 42 and CISA have repeatedly tied it to G0069 intrusions against telecom, government and defence targets across the Middle East and Israel from 2021 through 2024. The DLL search-order hijack abuses Google's signed updater so EDR allowlists pass the parent process, and the child-shell spawn is the seam: legi
